release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.15 adds Rush & Cash NL500 ($2.50/$5) and NL1000 ($5/$10), both with 100BB buy-ins, independent CPU population profiles, PokerCraft filters and BB/100 normalization. The new Casino page adds playable six-deck Blackjack (dealer stands on soft 17, natural pays 3:2, Hit/Stand/Double Down) and Punto Banco Baccarat (standard third-card rules, 5% Banker commission, Player/Banker/Tie bets). Casino wagers and payouts use the shared simulated wallet but remain separate from poker P&L. An unfinished Blackjack hand and remaining shoe persist across app restarts. The immutable 174-situation preflop chart and existing Run It Twice presentation are unchanged.
